truth: Score independently known 0x55 preamble; replay body disagreements are separately labelled.
noise_plane: White circular complex noise added at the already recorded 48k replay plane before rectangular integration. Recorded analog/FPGA/decimation filters are part of the fixed waveform. This does not simulate noise before the original physical filters or analog sensitivity.
normalization: Mean observed preamble sample energy minus idle sample power, times 40, is normalized to 1. Added noise N0=10^(-EbN0/10) minus estimated existing matched-filter complex noise variance; existing waveform/noise retained. Sufficient-statistic injection in fast section is exact for new white noise with frozen CFO/timing.
intervals: Independent injected-noise trial blocks conditional on each one fixed waveform. Normal cluster intervals for nonzero errors, sparse counts flagged. Zero-error upper bound uses independent trials, not differential bit independence.
paper: Ns=8, Nb=64, nu=0.10, phi=0, known PN Np=16/64, ML FFT with 16x zero-padding and parabolic interpolation, one preamble phase correction; independent NumPy RNG differs from MATLAB RNG.
